method: Exact code capture inserted at 1/9 native size; regenerate surrounding DNA as luminous orbs with subtle fibers. Larger nuclear background crop reused behind live 3D. Selected atom orb smoothly gives way to fine Hopf fibers on entry.
limitations: Published heavy atom DNA geometry with the existing guanine conformer substituted at A4 to maintain target hydrogen registration. Other hydrogens omitted. Display clouds are artistic covalent-contact envelopes, not measured density.
